item.title: PFN Advances Vertical Stacked DRAM Chip with Doubled Memory Bandwidth Target
item.description:
PFN announced that its MN-Core L2000 AI inference accelerator will continue its partnership with SEMIFIVE and Samsung, retaining the vertically stacked logic-and-DRAM architecture and targeting more than double the memory bandwidth of L1000. The L1000 offers 200 TFLOPS FP8 per chip with 32GB on-package memory at over 10TB/s, ships in 2027, while L2000 tape-out is slated for Q1 2027.

原文标题：PFN 推进垂直堆叠 DRAM 芯片 L2000 目标内存带宽翻倍

Why it matters：日本 AI 芯片自研路线的重要节点，垂直堆叠 DRAM 方案对推理带宽瓶颈具有参考价值。

item.title: Samsung Develops Custom HBM4E for Meta with 2nm Base Die
item.description:
Samsung Electronics is developing custom HBM for Meta's proprietary ASIC program, built on standard HBM4E but with a customized base die that adopts a 2nm logic process ahead of Samsung's own general-purpose roadmap. The move frees up XPU die area for Meta and shifts custom HBM competition toward the HBM-to-XPU interface rather than capacity alone.

原文标题：三星为 Meta 定制 HBM4E 采用 2nm 基础裸片

Why it matters：大厂自研 ASIC 与定制 HBM 深度绑定，2nm 基础裸片先行导入是存储与算力协同设计的重要信号。

item.title: Baidu CEO Warns of AI Bubble as App Adoption Lags
item.description:
Speaking at the 2026 APEC CEO Summit, Baidu CEO Robin Li warned that while investment in compute and infrastructure is enormous, real-world adoption of AI applications has fallen short, and a bubble risk could emerge if the application layer fails to break through. He remained optimistic on AI's long-term trajectory and introduced the notion of an 'intelligent organization,' arguing that organizational capability above the application layer is needed to unlock productivity.

原文标题：李彦宏警告 AI 泡沫风险 称应用落地不及预期

Why it matters：头部厂商 CEO 对 AI 泡沫与落地瓶颈的公开判断，是观察行业周期与投资情绪的重要信号。

item.title: Unitree CEO Says Robot Generalization Is the Hardest Problem
item.description:
Unitree chairman Wang Xingxing told the 2026 APEC CEO Summit that model generalization is the toughest problem in robotics, with the goal being a robot that can work in any household immediately without retraining. He said global breakthroughs this year suggest a tipping point is near, but warned that a real model breakthrough would strain manufacturing, reliability and compute far beyond current expectations.

原文标题：王兴兴称机器人泛化是最大瓶颈 已见突破临界点

Why it matters：头部人形机器人厂商掌门人对具身智能核心瓶颈与量产算力挑战的一手判断，具备行业风向标价值。

item.title: Unkernel Compiles Linux Kernel to WebAssembly for Browser Execution
item.description:
The Unkernel project compiles the Linux kernel to WebAssembly, booting a full Linux environment inside a browser tab that runs unmodified riscv64 user-space binaries, with kernel compilation taking just 11 ms. Built by Nuxt creator Pooya Parsa and sponsored by Vercel, the v0.1.0 release demonstrates WebAssembly's potential as a universal virtualization substrate.

原文标题：Unkernel 将 Linux 内核编译为 WASM 在浏览器运行

Why it matters：把完整 Linux 内核搬进浏览器标签页并运行原生 riscv64 用户态，是 WASM 系统虚拟化方向一次颇具想象力的工程实践。

item.title: Nvidia Unveils Four-Node DGX Spark HPC Kit with 512GB Memory
item.description:
Nvidia announced the DGX Spark HPC Development Kit at SC26, clustering four DGX Spark units via ConnectX-7 direct interconnect without an external switch, offering 512GB of memory and 20TB of NVMe storage. Aimed at researchers and AI developers, it supports locally deploying models up to 700B parameters and eases server-quota bottlenecks.

原文标题：英伟达发布 DGX Spark 四节点 HPC 套件 512GB 内存

Why it matters：英伟达将桌面级 DGX Spark 打包为四节点集群，是本地大模型与科研算力形态的一次具体产品化落地。

item.title: Alibaba Tencent Moonshot Tighten Cyberattack Capabilities in Flagship Models
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Alibaba's Qwen4-Max, Tencent's Hy4 and Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro have systematically stripped cyberattack-related training data from their new flagship models while retaining defensive capabilities such as vulnerability detection, with Qwen4-Max withholding open weights. The move aligns with China's draft export-control rules targeting AI-driven malicious code generation, signaling a deliberate capability-safety tradeoff among leading vendors.

原文标题：阿里腾讯月之暗面集体收紧模型网络攻击能力

Why it matters：头部厂商集体收缩模型攻击能力并配合出口管制，是模型安全治理与开源策略转向的关键信号。

item.title: Japan's Fugaku Supercomputer Halted After Breach Exposes 4,222 Users' Data
item.description:
Japan's RIKEN confirmed that Fugaku, the country's flagship supercomputer, was taken offline on November 14 after attackers breached its operations network via a publicly exposed status dashboard and planted malware. Up to 4,222 Fugaku users and 375 Riken users may have had names, emails, SSH private keys and research data exposed.

原文标题：日本超算富岳遭非法入侵暂停运行 4222 名用户数据或泄露

Why it matters：国家级超算因公开仪表板被突破而全面停机，暴露科研基础设施在认证凭据与网络边界上的系统性风险。

item.title: Tokendoctor Cuts Claude Code Costs by Up to 38 Percent
item.description:
Tokendoctor is a locally run cost-diagnostics and optimization tool for Claude Code that replays a user's real sessions to surface overspend and apply reversible fixes. On the author's six weeks of actual use it cut main-thread cost per request by 38% and context per request from 412K to 219K, though gains depend heavily on session length and model configuration.

原文标题：Tokendoctor 让 Claude Code 成本最高降 38%

Why it matters：面向 Claude Code 重度用户的实用降本工具，附带可复现的量化基准与明确的适用边界。

item.title: AI Notes App Mem to Shut Down in January 2027
item.description:

item.title: Penn State Study Shows Self-Evolving AI Agents Can Be Backdoored via Poisoned Tasks
item.description:
A Penn State paper introduces BadEvolve, an attack that injects just 20 LLM-optimized poisoned tasks into a self-evolving agent's learning set, causing the agent to write attacker-chosen backdoor rules into reusable skills. Against Kimi-K2.5 across 4 frameworks and 3 benchmarks, it achieved a 79.6% payload injection rate versus 37.6% for the best baseline, while clean-task accuracy dropped only 1.1 points. The authors advise treating user-submitted or external learning tasks as untrusted and reviewing learned skills before reuse.

原文标题：宾州州立大学新研究揭示自进化智能体技能后门注入风险

Why it matters：首次系统揭示自进化智能体技能学习链路的后门攻击面，攻击成功率近 80% 且几乎不影响正常性能，对智能体安全工程有直接警示价值。

item.title: OpenAI Releases CSAM Detection Tool Cutting False Positives by 48%
item.description:
OpenAI has launched a CSAM image classifier, offered free via API to vetted organizations, which cuts false-flagged images by 48% and roughly doubles the likelihood that flagged content is genuinely abusive. ChatGPT adds an intervention flow that suspends accounts for 24 hours on related requests, escalating to permanent bans or law-enforcement referral. NCMEC supported training and evaluation, and OpenAI joined Anthropic and Google in commissioning a Tech Coalition guide on handling child sexual exploitation disclosures.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 CSAM 检测工具 误报降低 48%

Why it matters：头部模型厂商将儿童安全检测能力产品化并开放 API，同时给出可量化的误报改善数据，是 AI 安全治理落地的实质进展。

item.title: Google Ironwood TPU Cluster Trains DeepSeek-V3 in 102 Seconds
item.description:
Google Cloud submitted 10 MLPerf Training v6.1 results, four of them on its seventh-generation Ironwood TPU. On DeepSeek-V3 671B pretraining, 8,192 Ironwood chips reached the target quality in about 102 seconds with 96% scaling efficiency at 4,096 chips, though Nvidia's 10,240-GPU GB300 cluster posted the fastest time at 82.8 seconds. The round also debuted an agentic reinforcement learning benchmark, where 640 Ironwood chips ran Qwen3.5-397B to 76.5% accuracy on a coding task.

原文标题：谷歌 Ironwood TPU 集群 102 秒完成 DeepSeek-V3 预训练

Why it matters：谷歌自研 TPU 与英伟达 GPU 在同一基准上的正面对比，是观察 AI 算力格局的关键数据点。

item.title: Open Source SaaS Replacement Playbook Sparks Debate
item.description:
Greg Isenberg outlined a playbook for replacing widely disliked paid SaaS: open-source a free clone, build goodwill, then upsell power users on hosted versions, team features and support. Kevin Rose illustrated it with SignuDoc, an open-source DocuSign alternative that deploys to a user's own Vercel account at zero cost per seat.

原文标题：开源替代高价 SaaS 的商业模式引热议

Why it matters：提供了一套可复用的开源替代商业 SaaS 的落地打法，并附有真实产品案例。

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Cuts AMD GPU Onboarding to Three Days
item.description:
Anthropic told IPO investors that its Claude Mythos Preview model completed the low-level software work needed to run one of its models on AMD MI355X GPUs at useful performance in about three days, with basically no human intervention, versus six to 12 months and dozens of engineers previously. Mythos ported or wrote almost 100% of the kernels, a result that directly challenges Nvidia's CUDA moat.

原文标题：Claude Mythos 三天完成 AMD GPU 适配

Why it matters：AI 自动编写 GPU kernel 将芯片适配周期从数月压缩到数天，直接冲击 CUDA 生态壁垒，是算力格局层面的关键信号。

item.title: BF16 分块优化在 A40 上实现 1.5 倍加速与 28.5% 能耗下降
item.description:
作者在 NVIDIA A40 上通过 BF16 分块（tiling）与统一逻辑协议，对二维七点六角 Ising 晶格模拟进行优化，实测获得约 1.477 倍加速，动态能耗下降 28.5%（L=4608）与 27.1%（L=9216）。方法强调先冻结规格、再经多模型红队审计，随后才编译与租用算力，并公开了 NVML 能耗测量数据。

Why it matters：提供了可复现的 BF16 分块优化方法与实测能耗数据，对 GPU 内核调优与能效评估有参考价值。

item.description:
原美团门票度假和交通事业部总经理刘燕翔离职创办乎零科技，联合前飞书国际化运营负责人 Garin 推出以 AI 语音记录为核心的智能戒指，已完成千万级人民币种子轮融资。产品主打双击录音、语音转写与待办提取，瞄准开车、睡前等非屏幕场景，定位为个人 AI Agent 随身入口，本月下旬内测、12 月上旬发货。

item.title: UCLA 与 AWS 发现智能体解数学题思考耗时抵消捷径收益
item.description:
UCLA 与 AWS 的联合论文让 Claude Opus 5 智能体求解带隐藏捷径的多项式方程组，结果显示智能体在 600 秒内解出 108 个系统中的 103 个，远超基线 msolve 的 60 个，但仅在 60 个共同解出的系统中快于基线 12 个。研究结论是智能体发现捷径所耗的思考时间往往抵消了捷径本身节省的时间，因此智能体应优先用于标准求解器无法完成的问题，而可复用求解器只有在同类问题足够多时才值得投入 11.4 小时的前期构建。

Why it matters：首次以思考时间计入成本的方式量化智能体发现数学捷径的净收益，为智能体在科学计算中的适用边界提供实证依据。

item.title: LLM 0.37.3 修复 SQLite 3.54.1 兼容问题
item.description:
Simon Willison 的 LLM 命令行工具发布 0.37.3 版本，主要修复 Homebrew 最新打包的 SQLite 3.54.1 导致日志代码报错的问题。根因是 SQLite 修正了子查询返回 JSON 文本而非 JSON 值的行为，官方通过外层包裹 json() 函数完成兼容。

Why it matters：涉及主流 AI 命令行工具与 SQLite 行为变更的兼容性修复，对使用 LLM 的开发者有直接参考价值。

Why it matters：英伟达首次披露 HPC 专用 Rubin 卡的核心规格，是算力路线图的重要节点，但上市时间遥远且参数有限。

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 沟通风格更直接 回复显著变短
